notes:
Refit R11 (Tue Oct 27 2026, frozen master, refit-Q01). Started from the dog-boarding overlay of the kennel pattern: a drop-off where the pet stays for nights or a daycare day, picked up by its owner or a named adult; van rides in flow B.
Names: Sam Lee's main company is Lee Pet Resort LLC (flow B: a boarding resort with van rides, the master's Lee Home Services; its second kind of work is daycare). His second company is Lee Pet Inn LLC (flow A: the master's Lee's Barbershop, a boarding inn at 450 Cedar St). Marisol and Kenji work at the inn; Nico and Eli drive the van and keep the kennel at the resort. Juniper, a 2-year-old Australian shepherd mix, is the example pet; Grace W. is the emergency contact.
Facts: animals (the pet's own care and vet record), dropoff (the stay starts and ends with a drop-off and a pick-up), extrawork (a bath before going home, a late pick-up), forms (the vet and vaccine forms on the secure page), multiday (the nights of a stay), spaces (runs, suites and cat condos, counted night by night). Settings: window (drop-off and pick-up windows; the van's windows in flow B); free cancel 24 hours before. No switches: no2 is off (the $2 applies, D97); no license or permit is checked by Rosie (D96).
Money, flow A (at the inn): list|card|counter (main: a standard run, 2 nights, $96; a card saved for the $20 fee; the pick-up payment at the counter); list|deposit|counter (a suite, 2 nights, $140; a $40 deposit when booked; the $100 rest at pick-up; the $40 is the fee if it's missed).
Money, flow B (van rides, the resort): list|card|card (main: a standard run with van rides both ways, 2 nights, $170; a card saved for the $25 fee; the card is charged $170 when the van brings the pet home and the resort texts DONE); list|deposit|card (a suite with van rides, $220; a $40 deposit when booked; the $180 rest charged to the saved card at DONE). Never a hold, never a rest on a set day; a late pick-up's extra night is priced only if the owner confirms.
Removed: any money taken early for a stay (no deposit beyond the suite's $40, no early charge), the money words with a set-day rest, the bank-transfer words for stays (the banktransfer fact is off), the money vary keys that tied with the master's variants, the license check on the plug-in (none, D96), the child-left and named-only splits (off), and the plumbing and towing words (renamed to the stay's own words).
Not sure (for the verifier): (1) a late pick-up's extra night ('charged only if Sam confirms') is one more night at the nightly price, the owner's word; (2) the daycare plan and pack are on the plug-in list but no money path lists a pack credit or a plan charge; (3) the $40 deposit is the fee for a suite and holiday stay.
